import pandas as pd
import glob
import os

# Get all sample files
files = sorted(glob.glob('CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx'))
print(f'Total sample files: {len(files)}')

# Define variant types to filter out
filter_out = [
    'intron_variant',
    '3_prime_UTR_variant',
    '5_prime_UTR_variant',
    '5_prime_UTR_premature_start_codon_gain_variant',
    'intergenic_variant'
]

# Process each file
results = []
for f in files:
    sample_name = os.path.basename(f).replace('230209_Exome_GRCh38_CHIP_', '').replace('.xlsx', '')
    df = pd.read_excel(f, header=[0, 1])
    
    # Find the Sequence Ontology column
    so_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Sequence Ontology' in str(c)][0]
    
    total_variants = len(df)
    
    # Filter out intronic, intergenic, and UTR variants
    mask = ~df[so_col].isin(filter_out)
    filtered_df = df[mask]
    filtered_count = len(filtered_df)
    
    results.append({
        'Sample': sample_name,
        'Total Variants': total_variants,
        'Filtered Variants': filtered_count,
        'Removed': total_variants - filtered_count
    })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

print('\n=== Per-sample variant counts after filtering ===')
print(results_df.to_string(index=False))

print(f'\n=== Summary ===')
print(f'Total samples: {len(results_df)}')
print(f'Total variants (all samples): {results_df["Total Variants"].sum()}')
print(f'Total variants after filtering: {results_df["Filtered Variants"].sum()}')
print(f'Total removed: {results_df["Removed"].sum()}')
print(f'\nAverage variants per sample (before filtering): {results_df["Total Variants"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Average variants per sample (after filtering): {results_df["Filtered Variants"].mean():.2f}')

# Show what was filtered
print(f'\n=== Variant types filtered out ===')
for ft in filter_out:
    print(f'  {ft}')

# Show remaining variant types
print(f'\n=== Remaining variant types (across all samples) ===')
all_remaining = []
for f in files:
    df = pd.read_excel(f, header=[0, 1])
    so_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Sequence Ontology' in str(c)][0]
    mask = ~df[so_col].isin(filter_out)
    remaining = df[so_col][mask].dropna().tolist()
    all_remaining.extend(remaining)

remaining_series = pd.Series(all_remaining)
print(remaining_series.value_counts())

    all_so.update(df[so_col].dropna().unique().tolist())
for v in sorted(all_so):
    status = 'FILTERED' if any(x in v.lower() for x in ['intron', 'utr', 'intergenic']) else 'KEPT'
    print(f'  {v} -> {status}')

print(f'\n=== FINAL ANSWER ===')
avg = results_df["Filtered Variants"].mean()
print(f'Average number of CHIP variants per sample after filtering: {avg:.2f}')
